svg.title: alan-factory usage example: centralized logging
svg.desc: An example project: research picks a log storage provider, architecture designs the setup, then the work is delivered either through several build chats or by a driver in a Claude Code loop that works through a roadmap file in the repository.
svg.text: From “where should our logs live?” to delivered code: explore first, then build, by hand or from a roadmap.
every agent working in this project reads its doc (read-only); you keep it current
pick your pace: drive each piece yourself, or let a driver work through a roadmap file
Open one Build chat per item
you are ready. Each one runs
the full build flow on its own
and reads the design from the
Build chat · “Add a structured JSON logger”
Build chat · “Add retention and alert rules”
Write the change list as a
A driver running in a Claude
each item is a full build iteration:
brief → plan → implement → review → fix → merge.
The driver moves on once the PR is merged.
The driver is just a Claude Code session: stop the loop to pause delivery, edit the roadmap file to change what comes next.
